# tx402 documentation

> tx402 is the spend-governance layer for x402 buyers: a non-custodial SDK (TypeScript + Python) that lets AI agents pay for HTTP 402-protected APIs safely — per-request caps, hourly budgets, and allowlists enforced *before* any key is signed, and, across a fleet sharing one durable store, a lifetime cumulative ceiling, an operator kill switch, and recipient pinning — plus deterministic multi-chain routing (Base + Solana), RPC-endpoint failover, and typed, ambiguity-safe outcomes. Buyer-side only: it never custodies funds, calls a facilitator's verify/settle, or bridges/swaps. This site is the official documentation. A clean Markdown version of any page is available by appending `.md` to its path (e.g. `/guides/policy.md`).

## Start
- [Quickstart](https://docs.tx402.io/start/quickstart/): install and make a first paid call in minutes

## Guides
- [Payment lifecycle](https://docs.tx402.io/guides/lifecycle/): the 402 handshake — decode, policy, reserve, sign, retry, commit
- [Policy](https://docs.tx402.io/guides/policy/): spend caps, cumulative and hourly budgets, allowlists, and recipient pinning enforced before signing
- [Routing](https://docs.tx402.io/guides/routing/): deterministic multi-chain routing and RPC-endpoint failover
- [CLI](https://docs.tx402.io/guides/cli/): the `tx402` command — paid calls and the five operator verbs
- [Migrating to 0.2.0](https://docs.tx402.io/guides/migration/): what changed, and moving a single process to a fleet on one budget

## Reference
- [Configuration](https://docs.tx402.io/reference/configuration/): every client and policy option
- [Errors](https://docs.tx402.io/reference/errors/): the typed error taxonomy and exit codes
- [TypeScript API](https://docs.tx402.io/reference/api-typescript/): exported types and functions

## Security
- [Security model](https://docs.tx402.io/security/): trust boundary, the data/admin-state boundary, and non-custodial design
- [Key handling](https://docs.tx402.io/security/keys/): signer abstraction and key management

## Operations
- [Shared spend store](https://docs.tx402.io/operations/shared-store/): give a fleet one authoritative budget on Redis (self-hosted or Upstash)
- [Capability gateway](https://docs.tx402.io/operations/gateway/): the service that holds the store credential and hands clients a scoped data/admin token
- [Durable Object store](https://docs.tx402.io/operations/durable-object/): the Cloudflare Workers store and its id-per-scope vs single-coordinator topology
- [Kill switch](https://docs.tx402.io/operations/kill-switch/): freeze spending for one merchant scope or the whole store
- [Recipient rotation](https://docs.tx402.io/operations/recipient-rotation/): pin a merchant's payout address and rotate it safely
- [Exposed reconciliation](https://docs.tx402.io/operations/exposed-reconciliation/): resolve maybe-settled payments that keep holding budget
- [Running the test merchant](https://docs.tx402.io/operations/running/)
- [Base Sepolia testnet runbook](https://docs.tx402.io/operations/base-testnet/): fund and verify the Base Sepolia test wallet for the opt-in live suite
- [Solana Devnet runbook](https://docs.tx402.io/operations/solana-devnet/): fund and verify the Solana Devnet test wallet for the opt-in live suite
- [Releasing](https://docs.tx402.io/operations/releasing/)
- [Release manifest](https://docs.tx402.io/operations/release-manifest/)
- [Publishing](https://docs.tx402.io/operations/publishing/)

## Source and packages
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/neogeeks/tx402): source, issues, and full history (Apache-2.0)
- [npm: tx402](https://www.npmjs.com/package/tx402) · [PyPI: tx402](https://pypi.org/project/tx402/)
- [Changelog](https://github.com/neogeeks/tx402/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) · [Security policy](https://github.com/neogeeks/tx402/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
- [tools.tx402.io](https://tools.tx402.io/llms.txt): free hosted utilities for x402 endpoints — inspect what one charges, verify a challenge before signing, test a spend policy, compare endpoints. Every result is available as JSON or Markdown.
